subject: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood Inference / Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood Inference / Acme Corp

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Use case: customer support summarization + internal knowledge search for 10k weekly chats; latency target ~300ms 95th on short responses, throughput ~200 rps during business hours.
- Decision criteria: accuracy on proprietary KB, SLA/uptime, cost per 1k tokens, security (SOC2 + data isolation options).
- Timeline: procurement + budget decision by end of Q1 (targeting ~Mar 2027).

Requested items from your side: any procurement requirements / PO process, and who’s the budget owner we should loop into pricing.

Proposed next steps (from our side):
1) I’ll send a ballpark pricing sheet and a one-pager on deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
2) Can we schedule a 30-min sync with your budget owner and procurement to go over pricing and contract timeline?
3) We’ll share SOC2 Type II and a short answers doc to your security questionnaire.

Attachments: Redwood-one-pager.pdf; Redwood-pricing-ballpark.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up tomorrow with the materials.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0122

Attachment stubs: Redwood-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood-pricing-ballpark.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Date: 2026-12-09T09:25:00-08:00

Marissa — great recap, thanks. Quick answers:

- Budget owner: looping in Jason Miller (CFO) — jason.miller@acme.com. He’ll own the budget/approval.
- Procurement: I’ve cc’d our procurement mailbox (procurement@acme.com) who will drive the PO process and any standard legal redlines.
- Timeline: Agreed — aiming to finalize vendor decisions by end of Q1.

I attached our initial requirements doc (Acme-requirements-v1.docx) — highlights the data residency and encryption questions you’ll see. Jason, Patricia — Marissa will send a pricing ballpark and SOC2 link; can we find 30 minutes next week for intro?

Thanks,
Alex

Acme Corp

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — Redwood Inference / Acme Corp

Hi Alex, Jason — thanks for the intro and Patricia/Procurement cc. Jason — great to e-meet you. Short note to share the items we discussed:

- Attached: ballpark pricing (Redwood-pricing-ballpark.xlsx) and a one-pager (Redwood-one-pager.pdf) that outlines hosted / dedicated / private options and typical economics.
- Security: we can circulate our SOC2 Type II report via a secure link (see below) or provide a redacted PDF for procurement.
- Contracting: we support standard PO + MSA; procurement typically reviews our data processing addendum and standard SLAs.

Would you be available for a 30-min intro on Tuesday Dec 14 at 10am PT or Wed Dec 15 at 11am PT? I’ll include Vivek (solutions engineer) and Rishi (customer success lead) on the invite to cover deployment/ops and onboarding.

Next steps from Acme: confirm budget owner (Jason), procurement contact (Patricia), and any required security docs you need upfront.

Links: Redwood SOC2 Type II (shared link: https://secure.redwood.ai/soc2/2026)

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-10T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Acme — pricing / discount ask

Quick internal note — looping you both in because Acme is likely to request committed pricing for a Dedicated deployment if they want predictable cost and isolation.

Ask: if procurement asks for a 12–18 month committed discount, what flex do we have? My recommendation: start with standard list, offer a 15% commit discount for a 12-month Reserved Dedicated contract; escalate to Sales Ops for anything deeper.

Rishi — can you be on the call to discuss onboarding and SLA expectations? Vivek — please be ready to discuss technical fit and the private deployment option.

Thanks,
Marissa
